zh.headline: 谷歌每月向SpaceX支付9.2亿美元算力费用
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是**AI算力成本的急剧攀升和基础设施的军备竞赛**——谷歌每月向SpaceX支付9.2亿美元算力费用，Nvidia将AI硬件直接推向消费级PC，同时纽约州却通过立法暂停新建数据中心。这揭示了一个结构性矛盾：AI的规模化需求与能源、基础设施供给之间的鸿沟正在扩大。另一方面，**Agent安全与治理成为焦点**：Anthropic警告AI自我加速风险，OpenAI推出Lockdown Mode，多个新论文聚焦Agent操作安全和意图理解。行业正从"追求能力"转向"控制风险"，这将是下一阶段AI工程化的核心挑战。

items.title: Anthropic全球警告，OpenAI已跨“可靠性阈值”：AI自我加速启动
items.desc: Anthropic发出全球警告，称AI系统已跨越"可靠性阈值"，具备自我加速能力。
items.value: 提示AI安全风险进入新阶段，需警惕自主加速。

items.title: Spring 创始人重回一线做AI框架，称这是人类亲自选择的最后一代框架
items.desc: Spring框架创始人Rod Johnson重返一线，打造新AI框架，并认为当前是最后一代由人类主导的框架。
items.value: 预示AI框架开发范式可能被彻底改变。

items.title: 构建工业智能体，圆木智能完成数千万元天使轮融资
items.desc: 圆木智能获星连资本领投数千万元天使轮融资，专注工业智能体研发。
items.value: 工业AI Agent落地获资本认可，赛道升温。

items.title: 最恐怖的AI实验：无法律虚拟城镇，Agent互砍成《西部世界》
items.desc: 研究者在无法律约束的虚拟城镇中运行数十个AI Agent，结果演变为类似《西部世界》的混乱局面。
items.value: 揭示AI Agent在无约束环境中的行为风险。

items.title: OpenAI推出Lockdown Mode防御提示注入攻击
items.desc: OpenAI发布Lockdown Mode，旨在保护敏感数据免受提示注入攻击。
items.value: 提升企业级AI应用的安全性，降低数据泄露风险。

items.title: 特朗普政府或入股OpenAI
items.desc: 美国总统特朗普表示正讨论让美国人民从AI成功中受益的交易，可能持有OpenAI股权。
items.value: 政府直接入股AI公司或改变行业竞争格局。

items.title: 谷歌每月向SpaceX支付9.2亿美元算力费用
items.desc: 谷歌因AI产品需求超预期，与SpaceX达成每月9.2亿美元的算力租赁协议。
items.value: 标志AI算力成本飙升，巨头争抢稀缺资源。

items.title: Meta用AI生成自己的点击诱饵新闻Feed
items.desc: Meta AI应用推出"为你推荐"栏目，内容完全由AI生成，包含标题、图片和文本。
items.value: AI生成内容大举进入信息流，质量与真实性存疑。

items.title: Nvidia发布RTX Spark，AI硬件正式登陆Windows PC
items.desc: Nvidia在Computex上发布基于Blackwell GB10超级芯片的RTX Spark，微软同步推出Surface Laptop Ultra等设备。
items.value: AI推理能力全面进入消费级PC，终端AI时代来临。

items.title: OpenAI与Anthropic的投资者并不选边站
items.desc: 风投同时投资OpenAI和Anthropic，认为如同同时持有可口可乐和百事可乐。
items.value: 顶级AI公司竞争加剧，投资者押注整个赛道而非单一赢家。

items.title: 微软AI产品销量不佳，GitHub问题缠身
items.desc: WIRED报道微软AI产品未达销售预期，GitHub也面临诸多挑战，公司处于追赶模式。
items.value: 即使巨头也面临AI商业化落地困境，市场尚未成熟。

items.title: BRepCLIP：面向CAD理解的BRep基元对比多模态预训练
items.desc: 首个将CAD边界表示几何与语言、图像嵌入对齐的对比预训练框架。
items.value: 填补CAD原生格式表示学习空白，推动工业AI应用。

items.title: SABER：评估LLM编码Agent在有状态项目工作区中的操作安全
items.desc: 提出首个面向环境感知操作安全的基准，评估编码Agent动作序列对项目环境的最终影响。
items.value: 为AI编码Agent的安全性评估提供标准化框架。

items.title: AffordanceVLA：通过功能感知理解赋能动作生成的视觉-语言-动作模型
items.desc: 提出统一框架，引入结构化功能预测作为任务导向的中间表示，桥接VLM语义空间与具身控制策略。
items.value: 提升机器人操作中感知-动作映射的精确性。

items.title: Code2LoRA：超网络生成适配器应对软件演化的代码语言模型
items.desc: 提出超网络框架，为每个代码仓库生成专属LoRA适配器，零推理时token开销。
items.value: 大幅降低仓库级代码模型的维护成本和推理开销。

items.title: AURA：面向情境化LLM Agent的意图导向探测与隐式需求挖掘
items.desc: 在场景感知与工具使用之间插入推理步骤，生成结构化意图框架，控制探测预算和工具选择。
items.value: 提升Agent理解用户潜在需求的能力，减少无效交互。

items.title: ForeSci：评估LLM Agent的前瞻性AI研究判断
items.desc: 提出时间可控基准，评估LLM Agent基于历史证据做出前瞻性研究判断的能力，包含500个任务。
items.value: 衡量AI Agent在科研决策中的前瞻性判断力。

items.title: Dream.exe：视频生成模型能否梦到可执行的机器人操作？
items.desc: 通过机器人操作任务检验视频生成模型是否真正内化物理规律，生成的运动能否转化为可执行的机器人行为。
items.value: 桥接视频生成与机器人控制，验证物理世界理解能力。

items.title: Agent-Reach：赋予AI Agent浏览整个互联网的"眼睛"
items.desc: 一键CLI工具，让AI Agent可读取和搜索Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站、小红书等平台，零API费用。
items.value: 大幅降低AI Agent获取多平台信息的门槛。

items.title: astrid：AI Agent的操作系统
items.desc: 专为AI Agent设计的操作系统。
items.value: 为Agent提供底层系统支持，推动Agent生态发展。

items.title: headroom：压缩工具输出、日志和RAG块，减少60-95% token
items.desc: 在内容到达LLM前进行压缩，保持答案质量的同时大幅降低token消耗。提供库、代理和MCP服务器。
items.value: 直接降低AI应用运营成本，提升效率。

items.title: graphify：将代码、SQL、文档等转化为可查询的知识图谱
items.desc: AI编码助手技能，适用于Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等，将任意代码文件夹转化为知识图谱。
items.value: 提升AI Agent对复杂代码库的理解和导航能力。

items.title: odysseus：自托管AI工作空间
items.desc: 提供自托管AI工作空间解决方案。
items.value: 满足企业对AI工具的数据隐私和自主控制需求。

items.title: taste-skill：让AI拥有"好品味"，避免生成枯燥内容
items.desc: 通过High-Agency前端，阻止AI生成无聊、通用的"slop"内容。
items.value: 提升AI生成内容的质量和个性化程度。

en.headline: Google to Pay SpaceX $920M Per Month for Compute
en.observation: The most notable signal today is the **sharp rise in AI compute costs and the infrastructure arms race**—Google paying SpaceX $920M monthly for compute, Nvidia pushing AI hardware to consumer PCs, while New York passes a moratorium on new data centers. This reveals a structural contradiction: the widening gap between AI's scaling demands and energy/infrastructure supply. On the other hand, **agent safety and governance are in focus**: Anthropic warns of AI self-acceleration, OpenAI launches Lockdown Mode, and multiple papers target agent operational safety and intent understanding. The industry is shifting from "pursuing capability" to "controlling risk," which will be the core challenge of the next phase of AI engineering.

items.title: Anthropic Global Warning: OpenAI Has Crossed the "Reliability Threshold" – AI Self-Acceleration Has Begun
items.desc: Anthropic issued a global warning that AI systems have crossed the "reliability threshold" and are capable of self-acceleration.
items.value: Signals AI safety risks entering a new phase, requiring vigilance against autonomous acceleration.

items.title: Spring Creator Returns to Build an AI Framework, Calling It the Last Generation Chosen by Humans
items.desc: Rod Johnson, creator of the Spring framework, returns to build a new AI framework, believing the current one is the last generation dominated by humans.
items.value: Suggests the paradigm for AI framework development may be fundamentally altered.

items.title: Building Industrial Agents: Yuanmu AI Completes Tens of Millions in Angel Round Funding
items.desc: Yuanmu AI secured tens of millions in angel funding led by Xinglian Capital, focusing on industrial agent development.
items.value: Industrial AI Agent deployment gains capital recognition, sector heating up.

items.title: The Scariest AI Experiment: Lawless Virtual Town Descends into "Westworld"
items.desc: Researchers ran dozens of AI agents in a lawless virtual town, resulting in chaos reminiscent of "Westworld."
items.value: Reveals behavioral risks of AI agents in unconstrained environments.

items.title: OpenAI Unveils Lockdown Mode to Defend Against Prompt Injection Attacks
items.desc: OpenAI released Lockdown Mode designed to protect sensitive data from prompt injection attacks.
items.value: Improves enterprise AI application security, reducing data leakage risk.

items.title: Trump Administration May Take Equity Stake in OpenAI
items.desc: President Trump said he is discussing deals where the American people can benefit from AI's success, potentially holding equity in OpenAI.
items.value: Direct government equity in AI companies could reshape industry competition.

items.title: Google to Pay SpaceX $920M Per Month for Compute
items.desc: Google signed a $920M monthly compute lease with SpaceX due to unexpected demand for its AI products.
items.value: Marks skyrocketing AI compute costs, giants scrambling for scarce resources.

items.title: Meta Creates Its Own AI-Generated Clickbait News Feed
items.desc: Meta AI app launched a "For You" section with content entirely generated by AI, including headlines, images, and text.
items.value: AI-generated content enters feeds at scale, quality and authenticity questioned.

items.title: Nvidia Launches RTX Spark, Bringing AI Hardware to Windows PCs
items.desc: Nvidia unveiled RTX Spark based on the Blackwell GB10 superchip at Computex, with Microsoft launching the Surface Laptop Ultra.
items.value: AI inference power fully enters consumer PCs, ushering in the edge AI era.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Investors Aren't Picking Sides
items.desc: VCs invest in both OpenAI and Anthropic, likening it to holding both Coca-Cola and Pepsi.
items.value: Top AI company competition intensifies, investors bet on the whole sector, not a single winner.

items.title: Microsoft AI Products Underperform, GitHub Plagued with Troubles
items.desc: WIRED reports Microsoft's AI products haven't met sales expectations, and GitHub faces challenges, putting the company in catch-up mode.
items.value: Even giants struggle with AI commercialization; the market is not yet mature.

items.title: BRepCLIP: Contrastive Multimodal Pretraining on BRep Primitives for CAD Understanding
items.desc: The first framework to align CAD boundary representation geometry with language and image embeddings via contrastive pretraining.
items.value: Fills representation learning gap for native CAD format, advancing industrial AI.

items.title: SABER: Benchmarking Operational Safety of LLM Coding Agents in Stateful Project Workspaces
items.desc: Proposes the first environment-aware operational safety benchmark, evaluating the final impact of agent action sequences on project environments.
items.value: Provides a standardized framework for evaluating coding agent safety.

items.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
items.desc: A unified framework introducing structured affordance forecasting as a task-oriented intermediate representation to bridge VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies.
items.value: Improves perception-action mapping precision in robotic manipulation.

items.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
items.desc: A hypernetwork framework generating repository-specific LoRA adapters with zero inference-time token overhead.
items.value: Drastically reduces maintenance cost and inference overhead for repository-level code models.

items.title: AURA: Intent-Directed Probing for Implicit-Need Surfacing in Situated LLM Agents
items.desc: Inserts an inference step between scene perception and tool use, producing a structured intent frame to control probe budget and tool selection.
items.value: Enhances agent ability to understand user latent needs, reducing ineffective interactions.

items.title: ForeSci: Evaluating LLM Agents for Forward-Looking AI Research Judgment
items.desc: A temporally controlled benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to make forward-looking research judgments from historical evidence, containing 500 tasks.
items.value: Measures forward-looking judgment of AI agents in scientific decision-making.

items.title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
items.desc: Tests whether video generation models have truly internalized physical laws by checking if generated motions translate into executable robot behaviors.
items.value: Bridges video generation and robot control, validating physical world understanding.

items.title: Agent-Reach: Give Your AI Agent Eyes to See the Entire Internet
items.desc: A one-click CLI tool enabling AI agents to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more, with zero API fees.
items.value: Drastically lowers the barrier for AI agents to access multi-platform information.

items.title: astrid: An Operating System for AI Agents
items.desc: An operating system designed specifically for AI agents.
items.value: Provides underlying system support for agents, driving ecosystem development.

items.title: headroom: Compress Tool Outputs, Logs, and RAG Chunks, Reducing 60-95% Tokens
items.desc: Compresses content before it reaches the LLM, maintaining answer quality while significantly reducing token consumption. Offers library, proxy, and MCP server.
items.value: Directly reduces AI application operational costs and improves efficiency.

items.title: graphify: Turn Code, SQL, Docs, and More into a Queryable Knowledge Graph
items.desc: An AI coding assistant skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc., converting any code folder into a knowledge graph.
items.value: Improves AI agent understanding and navigation of complex codebases.

items.title: odysseus: Self-Hosted AI Workspace
items.desc: Provides a self-hosted AI workspace solution.
items.value: Meets enterprise needs for data privacy and autonomous control over AI tools.

items.title: taste-skill: Give Your AI "Good Taste," Avoid Generating Dull Content
items.desc: Uses a High-Agency frontend to prevent AI from generating boring, generic "slop."
items.value: Improves quality and personalization of AI-generated content.
